title: Beyond Modern Asymptotics for Log-Likelihood Ratios in Logistic Regression
summary: We characterize the finite sample behavior of the log-likelihood ratio statistic in binary logistic regression, uniformly over both the design and the target parameter. For $n\geq d\geq 3$, we determine, up to universal constants, its worst case $(1-δ)$ quantile over all fixed collections of design vectors and all target parameters: \[ d\log\left(\frac{e n}{d}\right)+\log\left(\frac{1}δ\right). \] This is a nonasymptotic analogue of the Wilks $χ^2_d$ phenomenon and requires no regularity assumptions on the design.
